positions.title: Director of Product Management
positions.description: Transitioned to a role in Product Management to use my knowledge of the Parcel industry, as well as technical knowledge, to drive product decisions that would be most beneficial and useful to our current and potential customers and to increase market share. Worked closely with Product Development teams to socialize the priorities and provide requirements for the Product Owners to consume, using Agile. In addition to Product Development, also worked with Professional Services, Sales, and Support to stay on top of market trends and needs. Continued to own the relationships with carrier and technology partner providers, and continued to act as a mentor to development teams during transition.

positions.title: Director of Product Development
positions.description: Continued to manage the 2 offshore development teams, after acquisition by e2open. Additionally, integrated and migrated Logistyx processes and tools into e2open, as well as handling management and HR structure changes. Provided guidance to the e2open executive team on Logistyx products, as well as the general industry. Also worked on a new cloud native, multi tenant, application that integrated with legacy applications that would drive cost reduction in infrastructure spend.

positions.title: VP of Product Development
positions.description: Managed 2 offshore development teams from different development organizations, one for the ADSI software, and another for the new Logistyx Carrier Team. Provided guidance to the developers on both teams to optimize efficiency. Interacted and built relationships with carrier and other technology partner providers in order to write up specifications for the developers to consume. Acted as a liaison between the Product Development teams and both Professional Services and Product Management, as well as an escalation path for critical issues.

positions.title: VP of Professional Services
positions.description: Managed the Professional Services team and projects using my experience as a Senior Engineer and Software Support Specialist at the company. Also worked with customers to architect and design the solution, integration, and support of new ADSI Shipping Systems and Mobile Solutions.

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description: Designed and developed ADSI Shipping Solutions as well as mobile warehouse solutions for Motorola/Symbol devices primarily using C#, VB6, and VBScript. Created interfaces between the software and a wide array of customer databases, such as: MS SQL Server, Oracle, and AS400 for TMS or WMS functionality.

positions.title: Software Support
positions.description: Provided software support for ADSI Shipping Solutions, troubleshooting compiled or scripted business rules (primarily C#, VB6, or VBScript) and database data integrity.
